supported_criteria.label: Net Sales EUR 15-200M
supported_criteria.source_excerpt: Our target companies typically have net sales in the range of EUR 15–200 million euros. We also invest in smaller companies, particularly when the goal is significant growth through acquisitions or industry consolidations.

supported_criteria.label: Finnish Domicile & Profitable Operations
supported_criteria.source_excerpt: Sponsor Capital is looking to invest in Finnish companies with net sales in the range of 15–200 million euros and stable and profitable operations.

supported_criteria.label: Management Partnership & 4-7 Year Horizon
supported_criteria.source_excerpt: We invest together with the portfolio company's management and key personnel. An incentivising and rewarding ownership structure is built for management... Our typical ownership period is 4–7 years.
